$Comment: The Flaming Jack Shield, the charred and sturdier Jack Shield, for players Exalted with the Hallowed (Hallows_Eve_Hallowed), the longest climb the season has. The Requires block locks it until then; a locked offer still shows on the shelf, so a player can see what to work towards. The plain Jack Shield speeds the climb: while it is equipped, every gain of favor with the Hallowed is a percentage bigger. It is an upgrade: the player trades in a plain Jack Shield (Cost.Items) and pays sweets on top (Cost.Currencies), and with Combine left out both are charged. Together they come to 800 sweets' worth, the Jack Shield counted at its own price on this stall (150), level with the Scrap Glider and the Hookshot as the dearest things on the stall, so sweets saved over the years have somewhere to go. Only a shield carried in the bag, storage or hotbar is taken, never one in the utility slot, so a player with the plain shield in the off hand moves it to the bag or hotbar before buying. The Horseman's Hoard sometimes pays one too. Named by the item's own keys; the flavor is the description that names both of its sets.
